module Concurrency.AwaitChannelSendReceive

async function exchange(sender: Sender<Integer>, receiver: Receiver<Integer>) returns Integer
is
    let sent: Boolean = await channel_send<Integer>(sender, 42)
    check sent = true
    let item: Integer = await channel_receive<Integer>(receiver)
    return item
end exchange

end Concurrency.AwaitChannelSendReceive
